description.content: Operations related to default and main endpoints on OmniChannel.

Use this endpoint to retrieve a comprehensive list of all connected channels within the **OmniChannel** product.

<!-- theme: success -->
> #### 🔢 Pagination
>
> This endpoint enables pagination by using a `page_id` parameter, which is included in the request query parameters. Each payload retrieves **10** channels.

query.description: (Required) This specifies the product name, which in this case is `omnichannel`.
(Required) This adds a `page_id` for the subsequent payload. The current page can be identified by the `"page_number": "1"` attribute in the initial payload.

header.description: (Required) This is used to add the `API key` generated from your Lucidya account to authenticate.

response.name: A list of channels

Use this endpoint to create a request for X widget names and get the `job_id` to [get widgets analysis for the channel

<!-- theme: info -->
> #### Note
>
> You can specify a maximum of **5 widget names** and apply a Unix date filter for **up to 30 days**.

<!-- theme: success -->
> #### Tip
>
> Use `page_name` as `TWITTER_PUBLIC` for Twitter public channel or `TWITTER_PRIVATE` for Twitter private (direct message) channel to can get the required widgets.
